scope.study: LaRue et al (2024) Proc R Soc B remote-sensing global emperor colony panel

critical_primary_readme_definitions.bpresent_Yes: Birds detected on the satellite image
critical_primary_readme_definitions.bpresent_No: No birds visible in inspected image OR no fast ice platform present at that colony site
critical_primary_readme_definitions.bpresent_NA: No usable image OR corrupted imagery OR image too low quality for presence determination
critical_primary_readme_definitions.catalog_id_missing_literal_NA: Image unavailable for that location and year
critical_primary_readme_definitions.catalog_id_blank_string: Fretwell et al (2012) original images not re-analyzed in this study; NOT proof an image was unavailable
critical_primary_readme_definitions.img_date: actual image observation date, necessary for seasonal stage and ice phenology
critical_primary_readme_definitions.comments: free-text remote-sensing analyst comments to inspect ONLY with advance-gated outcomes if disambiguation possible
critical_primary_readme_definitions.area_m2: visible penguin pixel area, not pair count or successful breeding

state_logic.positive_detected: bpresent == Yes → image has visible birds; not necessarily successful breeding
state_logic.negative_composite: bpresent == No → could be physically no ice or ice with no birds; cannot be a known available vacant refuge
state_logic.missing_composite: bpresent == NA → not a biological zero
state_logic.eligible_biological_empty_when_ice_prese: requires contemporaneously independently verified stable fast ice, adequate imagery at relevant stage and true image-reviewed no birds; not derivable from bpresent alone
state_logic.site_formation: does not establish zero→positive when old site image only/no ice or current group migrates elsewhere within same physical local network

derived_note: P(Y=No) combines P(ice unavailable) and P(ice available, birds visually absent); naive modeling Y=No as vacant suitable habitat conflates the very physical-access vs behavioral-establishment causes under test.
